recommendations.scene: Paul addresses the people of Athens
recommendations.brief: Paul stands among an attentive and questioning Athenian audience, explaining the giver of life and humanity’s relationship to God. Vary listener responses rather than showing universal conversion.
recommendations.limits: No visible Heavenly Father or Christ appearing beside Paul. Verse23 recalls an altar he passed; do not claim it stood directly beside this speech. Exact council setting and ancient architecture remain interpretive. Dionysius and Damaris are named later among believers; no need to assign faces to them.
recommendations.purpose: Turns the page’s first major reading from a landscape abstraction into the specific teaching encounter; preserves Father/Son distinction.

principle: Recommend only2high-impact scenes; no blanket per-page minimum and no replacement/removal of existing approved pictures. Any addition requires generation/source/visual review and explicit interpretive captions.
